```{r}
## --- Packages ---
library(MCMCpack)     # rdirichlet
library(compositions) # acomp, clr
library(limma)

## --- 1. Simulator ---
simulate_topics_dirichlet <- function(
  N = 1000,
  G = 500,
  K = 5,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 123
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  # condition
  X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

  # topic-level effects
  mu_k   <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)
  diff_k <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), K, replace = TRUE,
                   prob = c(frac_diff, 1 - frac_diff))
  beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean = beta_strength, sd = 0.5), 0)

  # latent logits
  eta <- sapply(seq_len(K), function(k) {
    rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
  })

  # softmax topic proportions
  softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
  Z <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))
  stopifnot(all(abs(rowSums(Z) - 1) < 1e-8))

  # topic-gene weights
  T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K * G, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 1), K, G)
  W <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) MCMCpack::rdirichlet(1, a)))
  rownames(W) <- paste0("Topic", seq_len(K))

  # library sizes and dispersions
  l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
  alpha_g <- rexp(G, rate = 0.2)

  # mean expression
  mean_ng <- (Z %*% W) * l_n

  # gamma-poisson counts
  X_ng <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = N, ncol = G)
  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    shape <- alpha_g[g]
    rate  <- alpha_g[g] / mean_ng[, g]
    X_ng[, g] <- rgamma(N, shape = shape, rate = rate)
  }
  Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N * G, lambda = as.vector(X_ng)), N, G)

  list(
    Y = Y_ng,
    Z = Z,
    W = W,
    beta_true = beta_k,
    diff_topics = diff_k,
    diff_topic_ids = which(diff_k),
    X = X,
    mu = mu_k,
    alpha_g = alpha_g,
    library_size = l_n
  )
}

## --- 2. One-run CLR + limma ---
run_one_sim_clr <- function(
  N = 1000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 1
) {
  sim <- simulate_topics_dirichlet(
    N = N, G = G, K = K,
    frac_diff = frac_diff,
    beta_strength = beta_strength,
    seed = seed
  )

  Z <- sim$Z
  X_cond <- sim$X
  true_topics <- sim$diff_topics

  Z_clr <- clr(acomp(Z))
  colnames(Z_clr) <- paste0("Topic", seq_len(ncol(Z_clr)))

  design <- model.matrix(~ X_cond)
  fit <- lmFit(t(Z_clr), design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)

  res <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf)
  disc <- res$adj.P.Val < 0.05

  list(
    disc = disc,
    true_topics = true_topics,
    pvals = res$P.Value,
    adj_pvals = res$adj.P.Val,
    res = res,
    sim = sim
  )
}

## --- 3. Metrics ---
compute_metrics <- function(disc, true_topics) {
  power <- if (any(true_topics)) mean(disc[true_topics]) else NA_real_

  n_disc <- sum(disc)
  emp_fdr <- if (n_disc == 0) {
    0
  } else {
    sum(disc & !true_topics) / n_disc
  }

  list(power = power, emp_fdr = emp_fdr)
}

## --- 4. Bootstrap stability on one simulated dataset ---
stability_for_dataset <- function(sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05) {
  Z <- sim$Z
  X <- sim$X
  K <- ncol(Z)

  disc_mat <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = B, ncol = K)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Z)), replace = TRUE)
    Z_b <- Z[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_b <- X[idx]

    Z_clr_b <- clr(acomp(Z_b))
    design_b <- model.matrix(~ X_b)

    fit_b <- lmFit(t(Z_clr_b), design_b)
    fit_b <- eBayes(fit_b)
    res_b <- topTable(fit_b, coef = 2, number = Inf)

    disc_mat[b, ] <- res_b$adj.P.Val < fdr_thresh
  }

  topic_freq <- colMeans(disc_mat)

  jaccard <- function(a, b) {
    inter <- sum(a & b)
    union <- sum(a | b)
    if (union == 0) return(NA_real_)
    inter / union
  }

  pair_ids <- combn(B, 2)
  jacc_vals <- apply(pair_ids, 2, function(ix) {
    jaccard(disc_mat[ix[1], ], disc_mat[ix[2], ])
  })

  list(
    topic_freq = topic_freq,
    mean_jacc = mean(jacc_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    disc_mat = disc_mat
  )
}

## --- 5. Signal scenario across many simulations ---
run_signal_experiment <- function(
  R = 100,
  N = 2000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  B = 50
) {
  power_vec    <- numeric(R)
  fdr_vec      <- numeric(R)
  stab_jaccvec <- numeric(R)
  stab_avgfreq <- numeric(R)

  for (r in seq_len(R)) {
    out <- run_one_sim_clr(
      N = N, G = G, K = K,
      frac_diff = frac_diff,
      beta_strength = beta_strength,
      seed = r
    )

    m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$true_topics)
    power_vec[r] <- m$power
    fdr_vec[r]   <- m$emp_fdr

    stab <- stability_for_dataset(out$sim, B = B, fdr_thresh = 0.05)
    stab_jaccvec[r] <- stab$mean_jacc
    stab_avgfreq[r] <- mean(stab$topic_freq)
  }

  list(
    power_vec = power_vec,
    fdr_vec = fdr_vec,
    stab_jaccvec = stab_jaccvec,
    stab_avgfreq = stab_avgfreq
  )
}

## --- 6. Null scenario across many simulations ---
run_null_experiment <- function(
  R = 100,
  N = 2000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  beta_strength = 2
) {
  fdr_vec <- numeric(R)

  for (r in seq_len(R)) {
    out <- run_one_sim_clr(
      N = N, G = G, K = K,
      frac_diff = 0.0,
      beta_strength = beta_strength,
      seed = r
    )

    m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$true_topics)
    fdr_vec[r] <- m$emp_fdr
  }

  fdr_vec
}
```

```{r}
out <- run_one_sim_clr(seed = 11)
out$res
out$disc
out$true_topics

m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$true_topics)
m$power
m$emp_fdr
```
## Signal scenario
```{r}
set.seed(999)
sig_res <- run_signal_experiment(R = 100, B = 50)

cat("=== CLR + limma : SIGNAL scenario ===\n")
cat("Mean power across sims          =", round(mean(sig_res$power_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR across sims  =", round(mean(sig_res$fdr_vec), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean Jaccard stability          =", round(mean(sig_res$stab_jaccvec, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean topic discovery frequency  =", round(mean(sig_res$stab_avgfreq, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
```

## null
```{r}
set.seed(999)
null_fdr <- run_null_experiment(R = 100)

cat("=== CLR + limma : NULL scenario ===\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR across sims =", round(mean(null_fdr), 3), "\n")
```

## one dataset
```{r}
out1 <- run_one_sim_clr(
  N = 2000, G = 300, K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4, beta_strength = 2, seed = 123
)

m1 <- compute_metrics(out1$disc, out1$true_topics)
stab1 <- stability_for_dataset(out1$sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05)

cat("=== CLR + limma : single run ===\n")
cat("Power =", round(m1$power, 3), "\n")
cat("Empirical FDR =", round(m1$emp_fdr, 3), "\n")
cat("Mean Jaccard stability =", round(stab1$mean_jacc, 3), "\n")

topic_summary <- data.frame(
  Topic = paste0("Topic", seq_along(stab1$topic_freq)),
  TrueDiff = out1$true_topics,
  DiscoveryFreq = round(stab1$topic_freq, 3)
)
print(topic_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```
